question: Oda-chi, hello!! What is the crackling thing at the tips of Sweet Commander Cracker's hair? How is Cracker wearing his mantle? - Mochi Donut
answer: Well, the mantle is held in place by "spirit" like always, so the issue would be the crackling part. The truth is, I drew the this crackling while wondering what it is myself. Ahahahahaha. When I was designing him, it was just something cool to draw. "Well, it's good or whatever", I thought and I drew it. If you retrofit it, you can kind of get the image of a "Firecracker" from the name "Cracker". So it's the fuse to that?
name: Mocchi Mochi Donut
